summary: Lotus Technology Inc. (Nasdaq: LOT) filed a Form 6-K announcing its strategic acquisition of Lotus UK, expected to close in 2026. The acquisition, structured as a common-control transaction, aims to unify brand positioning and improve operational efficiency under the 'One Lotus' strategy. No financial terms—price per share, premium, or consideration—were disclosed. The board has not publicly stated a recommendation or named advisors. Lotus Tech temporarily suspended Q1 and Q3 2026 earnings releases to prioritize compliance work for the deal. Integration planning covers regulatory filings, SOX compliance, and system alignment. Key watch: risk-arb hinge on completion timeline and synergy realization given the lack of disclosed terms.
